overview: GENREP reconciles visual perception and generation in a unified diffusion model by transferring distributional knowledge via MCMC approximation for perception, using semantic embeddings to drive generation, and harmonizing both tasks through symmetric gradient alignment.

modules.name: Multimodal Dataset Loader & Augmentation
modules.description: Handles data loading, parsing, and augmentation for diverse datasets (classification, segmentation, depth, detection, and generation), implementing task-specific transformations like random cropping, flipping, and resizing to standardize inputs for the diffusion backbone.

modules.name: Diffusion Backbone & Latent Encoder
modules.description: Implements the core diffusion model architecture (supporting CNN-based LDM and ViT-based DiT) along with the pre-trained VQGAN encoder/decoder for mapping between pixel space and latent space, providing the foundational forward and reverse diffusion processes.

modules.name: Task-Specific Decoders Hub
modules.description: Integrates various task-specific prediction heads, including MLP for classification, Mask2Former for semantic segmentation, DETR-style Transformer for object detection, and BinsFormer-like architecture for depth estimation, all processing features extracted from the diffusion backbone.

modules.name: MCMC Distribution Approximator
modules.description: Implements the Markov Chain Monte Carlo approximation for the conditional distribution p(x|y) using intermediate states of the reverse diffusion process, incorporating burn-in and thinning strategies to select uninformative and decorrelated samples for distribution estimation.

modules.name: Generative-Discriminative Loss Calculator
modules.description: Computes the combined perception loss, which includes the standard discriminative loss for specific tasks and the generative distillation loss (KL divergence) that bridges the gap between the soft generative posterior and the discriminative logits.

modules.name: Semantic-Driven Noise Modulator
modules.description: Implements the semantic-aware noise adjustment strategy for the reverse diffusion process, dynamically modulating the predicted mean and variance of the noise distribution based on high-level semantic embeddings derived from the perception branch.

modules.name: Generation Loss Calculator
modules.description: Computes the overall generation objective, combining the standard latent diffusion model reconstruction loss with the representation alignment loss that enforces consistency between the generated image features and the semantic embeddings.

modules.name: Gradient Alignment Engine
modules.description: Implements the symmetric gradient alignment mechanism to resolve conflicts between perception and generation objectives, decomposing gradients into parallel and orthogonal components and applying an adaptive damping factor based on cosine similarity to harmonize optimization directions.

modules.name: Joint Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the two-stage training workflow: initially optimizing with perception loss only to obtain a semantic-rich denoising network, followed by joint optimization with gradient alignment and momentum-based updates for the semantic network weights to ensure stable feature provision.

modules.name: Perception Metrics Evaluator
modules.description: Calculates evaluation metrics for visual understanding tasks, including Top-1 Accuracy for classification, mIoU for segmentation, AbsRel and delta thresholds for depth estimation, AP for object detection, and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) for confidence assessment.

modules.name: Generation Metrics Evaluator
modules.description: Computes image generation quality metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), Inception Score (IS), Precision, and Recall to evaluate the fidelity and diversity of the synthesized images.

modules.name: Ablation & Component Study Manager
modules.description: Configures and executes ablation experiments to validate the contribution of individual components (MCMC approximation, semantic-driven generation, gradient alignment) and hyperparameter sensitivity (thinning interval, burn-in steps, task weights).

modules.name: Robustness & Calibration Analyzer
modules.description: Evaluates model robustness under out-of-distribution scenarios and noisy inputs by injecting forward diffusion noise, and assesses the reliability of predictions by calculating calibration errors, comparing against purely discriminative baselines.

modules.name: Unified Experiment Configuration & Tracker
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations for multiple datasets and model variants, handles logging, tracks training dynamics (loss, gradient norms, alignment metrics), and manages checkpoint saving/loading for both the unified model and the momentum-updated semantic network.
